environment.scope: repository-only correction. Sponsor-observed defect: after APPLY-067 the dashboard shows Vantage #4 COMPLETED/account 5017/19s but amount N/A and the GBP total excludes the 30 — the record has amount 30 but currency blank. Root cause (read-only prod, privacy-safe boolean probes only): the genuine Vantage SUBMISSION email states 'Currency Type: GBP' with the value on the NEXT line; the text parser read only an inline amount-currency (Amount:30.00 has none) and the HTML _LBL_CURRENCY fullmatch('currency') missed 'Currency Type'; the COMPLETION email states no currency, so the ADR-0093 repair (which re-parsed only the completion) stored blank. Fix: (A) parser reads a line-anchored 'Currency Type:' field (value on same or next line; Vantage opt-in; _norm_currency-validated); (B) the repair resolves the currency from the correlated SUBMISSION evidence, adds --expected-currency, and a currency-BACKFILL path for an already-completed row with a blank currency. NO model/schema change, NO migration, NO production mutation. Withdrawal #4 stays COMPLETED with a blank currency until a separately-gated repair.

expected_results: The Vantage SUBMISSION parses amount 30 AND currency GBP from a standalone 'Currency Type: GBP' field (value on the same or the immediately-following line). An absent currency stays blank (never invented); an unsupported token stays blank; a preceding 'Account Currency: USD' / 'Deposit Currency: EUR' / bare 'Currency:' line is NOT read (line-anchored + mandatory 'Type'); prose ('paid in GBP') is not read; a card number / account suffix / date is never read as the amount or currency.

The COMPLETION email states no currency; the governed completion/backfill resolves the currency from the correlated SUBMISSION evidence — a SINGLE non-blank currency across the correlation's candidates (conflicting ⇒ CONFLICTING_REQUEST_CURRENCY), absent ⇒ blank. --expected-currency, when given, must match a non-blank resolved currency (CURRENCY_NOT_EVIDENCED / CURRENCY_MISMATCH).

A currency BACKFILL on an already-completed, account-resolved row whose currency is blank: sets ONLY the currency, under an explicit --expected-currency, never overwriting a non-blank currency, and still enforcing the shared suffix + amount guards. A pure idempotent no-op never resolves currency (so a conflicting-currency correlation cannot break a no-op). Cross-owner candidates cannot combine (single-owner correlation).

Projection: once currency=GBP the row renders '30.00 GBP', no N/A, no 'Account unresolved'; withdrawal_metrics.completed_amount_by_currency sums it into GBP (owner GBP total 15.00 + 30.00 = 45.00); a still-blank-currency amount is excluded (no fabricated conversion).

Per-broker: currency_from_field is Vantage-only; Pepperstone/Dominion/TradersWay parsing + projections are byte-for-byte unchanged (the speculative _LBL_CURRENCY broadening was reverted after review).
Migration-free, no production mutation, no raw email / name / full account / card number / Message-ID in any output, commit, test, fixture, Notion or chat; fixtures synthetic.

Verified against the genuine retained evidence (submission -> GBP; completion -> None) and the adversarial attack cases (Account/Deposit/bare-Currency -> not used; empty-field/unbounded/prose -> blank). _LBL_CURRENCY reverted to its original (?i)currency.
